prerequisite_contract.environment: The complete main job environment is copied unchanged, including explicit event-commit selection and offline application defaults.
prerequisite_contract.installation: The exact main fresh-venv installation, desktop lock, supplemental test tools, package install and installed self-test are retained.
prerequisite_contract.full_runtime: The exact integrated lock assertion still requires all 56 name/version pins, plus the existing native pywin32 ABI check.
prerequisite_contract.native_runtimes: Existing selected OCR and FFmpeg preparation/verification is retained without another downloader, runtime policy or source pin.
prerequisite_contract.cold_start: Every native block 23–48 runs without the full source suites. No successful source-suite side effects are assumed.
prerequisite_contract.model: Main step 48 remains the same explicitly pinned build-time model acquisition and verification; no inference or vendor-quality qualification is added.
prerequisite_contract.checkout_bytes: The existing bibliography pre-checkout step is reused byte-for-byte to disable core.autocrlf. Project '* -text' and all main prerequisite/native blocks remain unchanged.

additive_binding.before: After main step 8 and before the first installed checks, an isolated -I -B installed interpreter verifies the exact event SHA/tree, clean tracked source, full tracked-source SHA256 map and complete installed carr_library/bootstrap package payload. Every tracked file also matches its exact committed Git blob: SHA1 over the canonical blob header and the same bytes used for SHA256, with the opened fstat byte size equal to the observed read count.
additive_binding.payload: The current explicit setuptools package/package-data inventory is compared exactly to both installed package roots. Every declared source/data file must match; extra non-bytecode package files are refused. Only ordinary __pycache__/*.pyc files are excluded, as interpreter-generated cache rather than packaged source.
additive_binding.after: Only after all copied gates succeed, the same source/interpreter/origin/payload identity must equal the saved before receipt. The owned temporary binding script SHA256 is checked before re-execution.

exact_source_bytes.api: SHA1(b'blob ' + decimal opened fstat size + b'\0' + actual streamed bytes) == ls-tree object identity

evidence_retention.upload: Always upload carr-library/ci-results using the existing pinned upload-artifact action, with an isolated artifact name and the same seven-day retention.
evidence_retention.raw_logs: Existing native Tee-Object outputs and typed producer receipts remain unchanged. Complete GitHub job stdout/stderr, including compilation/setup output not separately captured by its existing producer, must be retrieved after completion for the observed proof.
evidence_retention.incomplete: On an earlier failure the after-binding and later gates are skipped; surviving raw output and the before receipt do not constitute a full native PASS.

composition.required_next: Root must compose the independently reviewed search-continuation native fixture correction before selecting a fresh branch for execution. This source-only workflow component preserves the baseline probe unchanged.

limits: No CI run or native PASS is claimed by this component.
This earlier focused workflow does not replace full source, installed bundle, standard installer, artifact-read or final-main acceptance.

copied_source_byte_policy.name: Preserve the exact committed source bytes
copied_source_byte_policy.position: Before checkout, as a separate unchanged copied block; no main prerequisite block is edited.
copied_source_byte_policy.purpose: The existing reviewed core.autocrlf=false checkout preparation allows whole-repository raw-byte Git verification, including nonproject workflow files. No local content normalization or digest exception is permitted.

correction.source_review_gap: A clean normalized Git diff plus working-file hashes alone did not directly prove equality with each committed blob.
correction.inverse: Removing only the copied pre-checkout block and replacing the narrow hash-helper/call-site change reproduces the previous workflow byte-for-byte.
